items.heading: Bobotie
details: Key ingredients: ground beef, curry powder, dried fruit, egg custard
Cook ground beef with onion, curry powder and dried fruit.
Spread the spiced meat mixture into a baking dish.
Pour an egg and milk custard over the top.
Bake until the custard sets into a golden layer.

items.heading: Boerewors
details: Key ingredients: beef and pork sausage, coriander seed, nutmeg
Mix coarsely ground beef and pork with toasted coriander and nutmeg.
Stuff the seasoned meat into natural casing in a coil.
Grill over an open fire, turning to cook evenly.
Serve sliced with pap and a tomato relish.
